12.t: Working with data: frequency and wavelength
q: What is the wavelength at 4 Hz?
Describe the relationship between frequency and wavelength.
When frequency doubles, wavelength halves: they are inversely related.
Predict the wavelength at 16 Hz and explain using the wave equation.
0.25 m: speed = f × wavelength stays 4 m/s on the same spring, so wavelength = 4 / 16.
